verdict.rationale: Notte publishes an API reference section in its docs, including an authentication page with Bearer-token requirements and an agent-start endpoint page, and the docs contain code examples such as the HackerNewsFeed extraction model. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI spec paths that typically power such playgrounds all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable in-docs examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
